title: 第12章  与丫头的双修
slug: 让你当炉做鼎你炼阴阳证大道
content_zh:
赵元脸色一黑。
花弄影不给他反驳的机会，继续道：“我即将突破筑基。届时，我成为核心弟子，地位只会更高，而你呢？一个外门执事，这辈子也就这样了。”
“那也得突破才行。”
赵元阴沉着脸，冷冷道：“你在炼气期已经待了三年，若还无法突破筑基，这次宗门大考你必须拿第一，否则流落外门，到时候有你好受的。”
“那就不劳你操心了。”
花弄影烟杆一横，挡在李寒山身前，语气决绝：“今天这个人，我保定了。你若是识相，现在就滚。若是不识相......”
她顿了顿，眼中寒光乍现：“那就别怪我不客气。”
赵元脸色阴沉得能滴出水来。
他看了看花弄影，又看了看她身后的李寒山，眼中闪过一抹狠色。
“今天，他必须死。”
赵元冷冷道：“你保不住他。”
花弄影眸光一寒，不再废话。
她手腕一翻，烟杆在掌心转了个圈，一股浓郁的灵力从她体内喷薄而出，红袖翻飞间，数十道细如牛毛的针芒从烟杆中激射而出，铺天盖地地朝赵元罩去！
“你敢！”
赵元脸色一变，他万万没想到，花弄影竟敢主动对他出手！
李寒山则有些没想到，他以为花弄影故意躲着他不见，哪知这妖女关键时候居然前来救场。
有那么一瞬间，他还颇有些感动。但转念一想，妖女惦记他的功法，百分百舍不得他死。
不过，这妖女以炼气逆伐筑基，这份实力与胆识，倒是让李寒山对她高看了一眼。
与此同时，赵元见针芒袭来，冷哼一声，筑基期的灵力猛然爆发，在身前凝聚成一道半透明的灵力屏障。
“叮叮叮~~”

针芒撞在屏障上，发出清脆的响声，纷纷坠落在地。
“花弄影，就凭你这点手段，也敢对我出手？”赵元嗤笑一声，“炼气期终究是炼气期，你连我的防都破不了。”
花弄影却不慌不忙，红唇微启，轻轻吐出一口烟气。
那烟气与寻常烟雾不同，竟呈现出淡淡的粉色，如同一缕轻纱，无声无息地飘向赵元。
赵元起初不以为意，抬手便想将其扇开。可那烟气仿佛有灵性一般，绕过他的手掌，径直钻入了他的口鼻。
“咳咳~~这是什么鬼东西？”
赵元脸色骤变，只觉得一股甜腻入骨的气息直冲天灵盖，体内的灵力竟开始不受控制地躁动起来。
“你！你下毒？”
他猛地后退数步，运转灵力想要将那股气息逼出体外，却发现那烟气如同跗骨之蛆，根本驱之不散。
花弄影慵懒地收回烟杆，嘴角勾起一抹得意的弧度：“放心，死不了人。不过嘛，你越拖，你的灵力就越浓稠，直到彻底用不了。”
赵元脸色铁青，试着调动灵力，果然发现灵力变得凝滞无比。
“花弄影，你....你好歹毒！”
“歹毒？”
花弄影轻笑一声，烟杆在指尖转了个圈：“赵执事，这叫兵不厌诈。”
她向前走了一步，眼中寒光闪烁：“更何况，你要杀我炉鼎的时候，怎么不觉得自己歹毒？”
赵元恨恨地瞪了花弄影一眼，又恶狠狠地看向李寒山：“老东西，今天算你命大。但你给我
说完，他纵身跃起，化作一道流光消失在天际。
孙泽和几个跟班远远的看到这一幕，哪里还敢停留，连滚带爬地逃了个干净。
空地上，只剩下李寒山和花弄影两人。
花弄影转过身来，脸上的冷意消散，取而代之的是一副委屈巴巴的表情。

“主人，你可真不让奴家省心呢~”
她娇滴滴地开口，烟杆轻轻戳了戳李寒山的胸口：“人家才走了没几天，你就跑出来了。还跟外门执事杠上了，你这是嫌命长呀？”
李寒山干咳一声：“我这不闲得无聊吗？”
花弄影伸出纤纤玉手，轻轻抚上李寒山的脸颊，语气变得异常温柔：“主人，你以后可别再这样了。你要是死了，奴家可怎么办呀？”
李寒山看着眼前这张近在咫尺的绝世容颜，自然没有相信她的话。
“主人，我们先回去吧。”
花弄影挽住他的胳膊，拿出飞剑，带着他往院子飞去。
回到房间后，花弄影让李寒山在床边坐下，自己则从储物袋里掏出一大堆东西，一样一样地摆在桌上。
“主人你看，这是千年灵芝，这是血玉参，这是龙涎果.....”
她如数家珍地介绍着，每一样都是难得的灵药，散发着浓郁的灵气。
最后，她小心翼翼地拿出一个玉瓶，双手捧着递给李寒山，眼中满是期待：“主人，这个可是奴家花了大价钱才弄到的增寿丹。”
“增寿丹？”
李寒山一愣。
“嗯！”
花弄影重重点头：“主人你不是一直担心自己年纪大、寿元无多吗？这枚增寿丹可以延寿三十年。奴家这次出去，主要就是为了寻它呢。”
李寒山接过玉瓶，
他抬头看向花弄影，发现这妖女正眼巴巴地望着他，眼中竟有几分期待被夸奖的神色。
“你......专门为我寻的？”
李寒山不太相信。
“当然啦~”

花弄影脑袋轻轻靠在他肩上，声音柔得像一汪春水：“主人，虽然咱们一开始闹得不太愉快，但奴家现在是真的把你当成最重要的人了。”
她抬起头，那双勾人的眼眸里竟泛起了水雾：“你知不知道，你昏睡那两天，奴家有多担心？我怕你醒不过来，怕你......怕你就这么走了。”
李寒山沉默了。
他想起了花弄影离开前留下的那张纸条，想起了她说要为他寻延年益寿的灵丹妙药。
他本以为那只是借口，没想到她真去做了。
只是，这妖女真有这么好心？他不相信。
“主人~”
花弄影的声音带着几分哽咽，小手轻轻握住他的手：“奴家知道，你一直防着我，怕我筑基后会害你。可奴家对天发誓，我对你的心意，是真的。”
她说着，眼泪竟真的掉了下来，一颗一颗，落在李寒山的手背上。
李寒山看着那滴眼泪，心中某根弦被轻轻拨动了一下。
这妖女....难道真的动情了？
但...怎么可能？！
“好了，别哭了。”
他伸手擦去花弄影脸上的泪痕，温声道：“我信你。”
花弄影破涕为笑，扑进他怀里，双臂环住他的脖子：“主人，你真好~”
她抬起头，红唇微启，眼中波光流转，带着几分羞涩，又带着几分期待。
李寒山心头一荡，低头便吻了上去。
花弄影嘤咛一声，软软地靠在他怀里，任由他索取。
罗帐垂下，烛火摇曳。
一夜春色，自不必细说。

接下来的日子，花弄影对李寒山好得不像话。
每天早上，她都会亲自端来热气腾腾的药汤，伺候李寒山喝下；中午，她会变着花样弄来各种灵果灵膳，说是要给他补身体；晚上，她会乖巧地窝在他怀里，陪他说说话，讲讲宗门的趣事。
修炼上，她更是全力配合，从不提任何要求。李寒山说要修炼，她便乖乖脱衣；李寒山说要休息，她便温柔地为他按摩。
她甚至主动将自己原本藏着的一些灵石、丹药分给李寒山，说是“主人的就是我的，我的也是主人的”。
至于筑基的事，她一个字都没再提过。
仿佛她真的忘记了那个执念，甘心做李寒山的小女奴。
李寒山一开始还保持警惕，总觉得这妖女在憋什么坏水。可时间一长，他渐渐放松了。
毕竟，谁会拒绝一个千娇百媚、百依百顺的美人呢？
更何况，这美人还对他掏心掏肺，连增寿丹这种宝贝都舍得给他，还全力全意助他修炼，距离突破炼气四层才一个多月，他的修为都冲上炼气六层了。
“也许，她真的变了。”
李寒山这样想着，心中的防线一寸寸崩塌。
他开始享受花弄影的温柔，享受她的体贴，甚至开始依赖她的陪伴。
每天睁开眼，看到枕边那张绝美的容颜，他便觉得这合欢宗的日子，似乎也没那么难熬了。
时间，就在这样的温柔乡里悄然流逝。
这天夜里，李寒山沉沉睡去，再度进入了那个熟悉的梦境。
河边，青石上，洛璃依旧坐在那里，白衣胜雪，赤足轻晃。
“丫头。”
李寒山走过去，在她身边坐下，语气轻松：“我又来了。”
洛璃转过头，看向他的目光却有些异样。
“大爷，你最近是不是过得很舒服？”她问。

李寒山一愣，随即笑道：“还行吧。那妖女最近对我挺好的，也不提筑基的事了，好像转了性子一般。”
“大爷！”
洛璃打断他，声音陡然严肃起来：“你中了她魅术了！”
“什么？”
李寒山笑容一僵。
洛璃站起身来，小脸紧绷：“你看，你现在已经被她迷得神魂颠倒了！”
“我....我没有啊。”
李寒山辩解道：“我只是觉得她最近表现不错，可能....”
“可能什么？可能真心喜欢上你了？”
“大爷，你清醒一点！她对你施展了潜移默化的魅惑之术，让你慢慢放下戒心，对她产生好感。”
她走到李寒山面前，眉头紧蹙：“再这样下去，用不了多久，她说什么你都会信，她让你做什么你都会做。到时候，她让你把功法交出来，你也乖乖交？”
李寒山如遭雷击，整个人愣在原地。
潜移默化？
他仔细回想这些天的经历，越想越觉得不对劲。
花弄影对他的好，确实好得有些过分了。而且每次她靠近的时候，他总会不自觉地心跳加速，脑子里全是她的身影，连修炼都没心思了。
“我真中招了？”
李寒山总算反应了过来，这妖女的手段好高明，若不是丫头，他就完了。
洛璃叹了口气，语气软了下来：“大爷，这不怪你。那妖女修为比你高，魅术又防不胜防，你中招也是正常的。”
她坐回石头上，拍了拍身边的位置：“大爷，来坐下。我正好有一门炼神之法，可以帮你提升神识。神识强大了，自然能抵御魅术。”
李寒山依言坐到了洛璃对面，与洛璃掌心相抵。

洛璃脸颊微泛绯色，低声道：“大爷，这门炼神之法有些特殊，待会儿不管发生什么，你莫要抗拒。”
李寒山点头：“丫头，我知道的。”
洛璃运起炼神之法，助李寒山修炼了起来。
功法甫一运转，两人的神魂便如两泓清泉交汇，缓缓相融。那种感觉，难以言喻。
不是触碰，却比任何触碰都要亲密；不是言语，却仿佛千言万语都在无声中流淌。彼此的意识交叠缠绕，边缘渐渐模糊，你中有我，我中有你，仿佛在刹那间窥见了对方心底最柔软的角落。
温柔，缱绻，带着一丝微醺般的沉醉，让人不由自主地想要沉溺其中。
“这不相当于双修么.....”
李寒山突然有所明悟，像现在这般神魂交融，不是双修，胜似双修，区别在于停留在神魂层面，亦不如神魂双修那般深入。
“丫头....”他有些过意不去，觉得丫头牺牲太大了。
“大爷，别说话，专注一些。”洛璃轻声打断了他。
content_en:
Zhao Yuan's face darkened.
Hua Nongying did not give him a chance to refute, and continued: "I am about to break through the foundation establishment. By then, I will become a core disciple, and my status will only be higher. And what about you? An outer sect deacon, this is what you will do for the rest of your life."
"Then we have to break through."
Zhao Yuanyin had a sullen face and said coldly: "You have been in the Qi Refining Stage for three years. If you still can't break through the Foundation Establishment, you must get the first place in this sect's exam, otherwise you will be exiled to the outer sect, and you will suffer a lot when the time comes."
"Then I won't worry about it."
Hua Nongying raised her cigarette stick horizontally and stood in front of Li Hanshan with a decisive tone: "I'm going to guarantee this person today. If you know who he is, get out now. If you don't..."
She paused, and a cold light suddenly appeared in her eyes: "Then don't blame me for being rude."
Zhao Yuan's face was so gloomy that water dripped from his face.
He looked at Hua Nongying and then at Li Hanshan behind her, with a ruthless look in his eyes.
"Today, he must die."
Zhao Yuan said coldly: "You can't protect him."
Hua Nongying's eyes turned cold and she stopped talking nonsense.
She flipped her wrist, and the cigarette rod turned in a circle in the palm of her hand. A strong spiritual power spurted out from her body. As her red sleeves flew, dozens of needles as thin as ox hair shot out from the cigarette rod, heading toward Zhao Yuanzhao overwhelmingly!
"How dare you!"
Zhao Yuan's expression changed. He never expected that Hua Nongying would dare to take the initiative to attack him!
Li Hanshan was a little surprised. He thought Hua Nongying was hiding from him on purpose, but he didn't know that this demon girl actually came to the rescue at the critical moment.
For a moment, he was quite moved. But then I thought about it, the demon girl was thinking about his skills and she was 100% reluctant to let him die.
However, this enchantress built her foundation by refining her Qi against the enemy, and her strength and courage made Li Hanshan take a high look at her.
At the same time, Zhao Yuan saw the needle light coming, snorted coldly, and the spiritual power in the foundation-building stage suddenly exploded, condensing into a translucent spiritual barrier in front of him.
"Ding ding ding~~"
The needle light hit the barrier, making a crisp sound, and fell to the ground one after another.
"Hua Nongying, how dare you take action against me with your limited means?" Zhao Yuan sneered, "The Qi refining period is the Qi refining period after all, and you can't even break my defense."
Hua Nongying was unhurried, her red lips slightly opened, and she blew out a puff of smoke.
The smoke was different from ordinary smoke. It actually showed a light pink color, like a wisp of gauze, floating silently towards Zhao Yuan.
Zhao Yuan didn't take it seriously at first, and raised his hand to slap him away. But the smoke seemed to be spiritual, bypassing his palm and going straight into his mouth and nose.
"Ahem~~What the hell is this?"
Zhao Yuan's face suddenly changed, and he felt a breath of sweetness to the bones rushing straight into the sky, and the spiritual power in his body began to stir uncontrollably.
"You! You poisoned me?"
He took a few steps back suddenly, using his spiritual power to force the aura out of his body, but found that the smoke was like tarsal maggots and could not be driven away at all.
Hua Nongying lazily retracted the cigarette rod, with a proud smile on her lips: "Don't worry, no one will die. But, the longer you delay, the thicker your spiritual power will become, until you can't use it at all."
Zhao Yuan's face was livid, and he tried to mobilize his spiritual power, but found that his spiritual power had become extremely stagnant.
"Hua Nongying, you...you are so vicious!"
"Vicious?"
Hua Nongying chuckled lightly and turned the cigarette rod in a circle on her fingertips: "Deacon Zhao, this is called a soldier who never tires of deceit."
She took a step forward, her eyes flashing coldly: "What's more, when you want to kill my cauldron, why don't you feel that you are evil?"
Zhao Yuan glared at Hua Nongying hatefully, and then looked at Li Hanshan fiercely: "Old man, you are lucky today. But give me
After saying that, he jumped up and turned into a stream of light and disappeared into the sky.
Sun Ze and several followers saw this scene from a distance. They dared to stop and ran away completely.
Li Hanshan and Hua Nongying were the only two people left in the open space.
flowerNongying turned around, the coldness on his face dissipated, replaced by an aggrieved expression.
"Master, you really don't want to let me worry about it~"
She spoke delicately, and gently poked Li Hanshan's chest with the cigarette stick: "I just left for a few days, and you ran out. You even got into a fight with the deacon of the outer door. Do you think you have a long life?"
Li Hanshan coughed dryly: "Aren't I bored with my free time?"
Hua Nongying stretched out her slender hand and gently touched Li Hanshan's cheek. Her tone became extremely gentle: "Master, don't do this again. If you die, what will happen to the slave family?"
Li Hanshan looked at the peerless face so close in front of him, and naturally did not believe her words.
"Master, let's go back first."
Hua Nongying took his arm, took out the flying sword, and took him flying towards the yard.
After returning to the room, Hua Nongying asked Li Hanshan to sit down by the bed, while she took out a lot of things from her storage bag and placed them all on the table.
"Master, look, this is Millennium Ganoderma lucidum, this is Blood Jade Ginseng, this is ambergris fruit..."
She introduced them in detail, each of which was a rare elixir, exuding rich spiritual energy.
Finally, she carefully took out a jade bottle, held it in both hands and handed it to Li Hanshan, her eyes full of expectation: "Master, this is the longevity elixir that the slave family spent a lot of money to get."
"Longevity Pill?"
Li Hanshan was stunned.
"Yeah!"
Hua Nongying nodded heavily: "Master, haven't you always been worried about your old age and your short lifespan? This longevity pill can extend your life for thirty years. The main reason why I went out this time is to find it."
Li Hanshan took the jade bottle,
He looked up at Hua Nongying and found that the enchantress was looking at him eagerly, with a look in her eyes that looked forward to being praised.
"You... found it specifically for me?"
Li Hanshan didn't quite believe it.
"Of course~"
Hua Nongying rested her head gently on his shoulder, and her voice was as soft as spring water: "Master, although we were not happy at first, the slave family really regards you as the most important person now."
She raised her head, and there was mist in her seductive eyes: "Do you know how worried the slave family was during the two days when you were in a coma? I was afraid that you wouldn't wake up, that you... I was afraid that you would just leave like this."
Li Hanshan was silent.
He thought of the note Hua Nongying left before she left, and how she said she wanted to find a panacea for him to prolong his life.
He thought it was just an excuse, but he didn't expect that she would actually do it.
But, is this witch really so kind? He didn't believe it.
"Master~"
Hua Nongying's voice was choked with sobs, and she gently held his hand with her little hand: "The slave family knows that you have been guarding me, fearing that I will harm you after I establish the foundation. But the slave family swears to God, my feelings for you are true."
As she spoke, her tears actually fell, one by one, on the back of Li Hanshan's hand.
Li Hanshan looked at those tears, and a certain string in his heart was gently plucked.
Is this witch... is she really in love?
But...how is that possible? !
"Okay, stop crying."
He stretched out his hand to wipe away the tears on Hua Nongying's face and said warmly: "I believe you."
Hua Nongying burst into laughter, threw herself into his arms, and put her arms around his neck: "Master, you are so kind~"
She raised her head, her red lips slightly parted, and her eyes sparkling with a bit of shyness and a bit of anticipation.
Li Hanshan's heart skipped a beat, and he lowered his head and kissed her.
Hua Nongying let out a cry and leaned softly in his arms, letting him take what he wanted.
The tent was lowered and the candlelight flickered.
There is no need to go into details about a night of spring scenery.
In the days that followed, Hua Nongying was extremely kind to Li Hanshan.
Every morning, she would personally bring steaming medicinal soup for Li Hanshan to drink; at noon, she would get various spiritual fruits and spiritual meals in different ways, saying that she wanted to replenish his body; in the evening, she would be well-behavedDi nestled in his arms, chatting with him and telling interesting stories about the sect.
In terms of cultivation, she cooperated fully and never made any demands. When Li Hanshan said he wanted to practice, she took off his clothes obediently; when Li Hanshan said he wanted to rest, she massaged him gently.
She even took the initiative to give some of the spiritual stones and elixirs she had hidden to Li Hanshan, saying, "What belongs to the master is mine, and what is mine is also the master's."
As for the matter of foundation building, she never mentioned a word again.
It seemed as if she had really forgotten that obsession and was willing to be Li Hanshan's little slave girl.
Li Hanshan was still vigilant at first, always feeling that this witch was holding back some evil. But as time passed, he gradually relaxed.
After all, who would reject a charming and obedient beauty?
What's more, this beauty was so devoted to him that she was even willing to give him treasures such as the longevity pill, and she also devoted herself to helping him cultivate. It had only been more than a month since he broke through the fourth level of Qi Refining, and his cultivation had already reached the sixth level of Qi Refining.
"Maybe she has really changed."
Li Hanshan thought like this, and the defense in his heart collapsed inch by inch.
He began to enjoy Hua Nongying's tenderness, her thoughtfulness, and even began to rely on her company.
Every day when he opened his eyes and saw the beautiful face on the pillow, he felt that life in the Hehuan Sect was not that difficult anymore.
Time passes quietly in such a gentle countryside.
That night, Li Hanshan fell into a deep sleep and entered the familiar dreamland again.
Luo Li was still sitting there on the bluestone by the river, her white clothes were as white as the snow, and her bare feet were dangling lightly.
"Girl."
Li Hanshan walked over, sat down next to her, and said in a relaxed tone, "I'm here again."
Luo Li turned her head and looked at him with a strange look.
"Uncle, have you been very comfortable recently?" she asked.
Li Hanshan was stunned for a moment, then smiled and said: "It's not bad. The enchantress has been very nice to me recently, and she doesn't mention the matter of foundation building. She seems to have changed her temper."
"Uncle!"
Luo Li interrupted him, and her voice suddenly became serious: "You have fallen under her spell!"
"What?"
Li Hanshan's smile froze.
Luo Li stood up with a tight face: "Look, you are now fascinated by her!"
"I...I didn't."
Li Hanshan defended: "I just think she has performed well recently, maybe..."
"What could it be? Maybe I really like you?"
"Uncle, please wake up! She has exerted a subtle charm on you, making you slowly let down your guard and develop a good impression of her."
She walked up to Li Hanshan and frowned: "If you continue like this, it won't be long before you will believe everything she says and do whatever she asks you to do. When the time comes, she will ask you to hand over your skills, and you will do the same obediently?"
Li Hanshan froze on the spot as if struck by lightning.
Subtly?
He carefully thought about his experiences these days, and the more he thought about it, the more he felt something was wrong.
Hua Nongying was indeed too kind to him. And every time she came close, his heartbeat would speed up unconsciously, and her image was all in his mind, and he no longer even thought about practicing.
"Am I really being tricked?"
Li Hanshan finally came to his senses. This witch was so clever. If it weren't for the girl, he would be doomed.
Luo Li sighed and softened her tone: "Uncle, it's not your fault. That witch has a higher level of cultivation than you, and her charm skills are hard to guard against. It's normal for you to fall for her."
She sat back on the stone and patted the seat next to her: "Uncle, come and sit down. I happen to have a method of refining the gods that can help you improve your spiritual consciousness. When your spiritual consciousness is strong, you can naturally resist the charm."
Li Hanshan followed his instructions and sat across from Luo Li, palm to palm.
Luo Li's cheeks turned slightly crimson and she whispered: "Uncle, this method of refining gods is somewhat special. No matter what happens later, don't resist."
Li Hanshan nodded: "Girl, I know."
Luo Li used the method of refining gods to help LiHanshan started practicing.
As soon as the technique started to work, the two people's souls were like two clear springs meeting, slowly blending together. That feeling is indescribable.
It's not a touch, but it's closer than any touch; it's not a word, but it seems like thousands of words are flowing in silence. Each other's consciousness overlaps and entwines, and the edges gradually blur. There is me in you, and you in me, as if you have glimpsed the softest corner of each other's heart in an instant.
Gentle, affectionate, with a hint of drunkenness, people can't help but want to indulge in it.
"Isn't this equivalent to dual cultivation..."
Li Hanshan suddenly realized that the fusion of soul and soul like now is not dual cultivation, but better than dual cultivation. The difference is that it stays at the level of soul and soul, and it is not as deep as dual cultivation of soul and soul.
"Girl..." He felt a little regretful, feeling that the girl had sacrificed too much.
"Uncle, stop talking and focus." Luo Li interrupted him softly.
